snippet.title: The Signal: Stranded on Sirenis Trailer - 2025 Convergence Games Showcase
snippet.description:
The Signal: Stranded on Sirenis is a single-player survival craft game set on a mysterious alien planet that has ensnared you. Scavenge, build, extract, and survive your way through a dangerous world as you uncover the true intentions of this sentient planet and why it has brought you here. This trailer shows new gameplay and announces the game's Kickstarter, and featured in the 2025 Convergence Games Showcase.

Wishlist the game on Steam and apply to join the playtest: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1830110/THE_SIGNAL_Stranded_on_Sirenis/ 
Follow the Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/goosebyte/the-signal-indie-game
